name: Sunroom
summary: A house listing card with a drawn photo strip you can swipe, an evening view and a visit booking
about: A property card for a corner house in Lahore. Its four photos are SVG drawings with parallax layers, so the plants and lamps slide faster than the walls when you swipe. Switch on Evening view and the sky darkens while windows, pendants and string lights switch on one after another. The instalment estimate rolls as you change the down payment and term, and booking a visit ends with a key turning in a lock and a real calendar file.
how: Swipe or drag the photos, use the arrows, the dots or the arrow keys; a flick moves one photo.
Turn on Evening view to see every room with its lights on.
Move the down payment slider and pick a term to see the monthly instalment roll.
Tap the heart to save the house.
Book a visit: pick a day and a time, confirm, then add it to your calendar.
